# Coxeter Polytopes Frontier Project

This repository pursues the research objective in [GOAL.md](GOAL.md) using the
dual-track programme in [RESEARCH_PLAN.md](RESEARCH_PLAN.md).

The [completed proof](results/fresh_depth6_dimension59_20261018.md) gives
**dimension at most 59 for every finite-sided, finite-volume real hyperbolic
Coxeter polytope**. This is a complete, internally checked computer-assisted
proof with no identified unresolved mathematical step. Internal agent reviews
and exact checks have been supplied; external mathematician refereeing and
proof-assistant formalization have not. Compact arithmetic remains at most21,
and arbitrary compact Coxeter polytopes remain at most29. No new finite-volume
example is established.

The [current search checkpoint](results/dimension59_three_corner_payments_and_oblique_closure_20261018.md)
combines new whole-corner finite transfers and the order15 ideal refinement.
Every added payment is included: the complete ambient59 finite maximum
falls397.5 to396.5, still above curvature391.5, with nine representative
obstructions. Six of1,890 terminal ideal profiles remain negative. This
progress does not yet prove dimension58 and does not leave a gap in the
completed proof of59.

The [bound-completion checkpoint](results/dimension59_complete_and_current_search_20261018.md)
closes the ambient60 comparison. A complete coupon-output audit removes two
smaller-component obstructions. The new depth-six finite-distance-seven theorem
uses two forced E10 supporting-white configurations and766 exact Schur cases.
Its remaining case forces a retained whole-component leaf payment. All current
triangle and quadrilateral payments survive without a new coupon.

The complete finite maximum is **404**, below curvature405, attained formally
by4A15. All1,044 fixed vectors and1,042 residual certificates are covered;
actual A15=101 is kept distinct from actual D15=100.5. All2,113 ideal terminal
profiles are positive, and the positive concentration argument supplies actual
cusp surplus at least54. The contradiction is

    0 >= v_f + 54 v_i + 4500 > 0.

The [completed predecessor](results/fresh_order11_order16_dimension60_20261018.md)
excludes every higher dimension. The final proof binds the local theorem and
discharges the counting certificate's geometric hypothesis. A
[prose clarification](results/fresh_depth6_sparse_ambient60_forest_frontier_20261018_domain_clarification.md)
records that residual D17 is included while A17 is separately fixed; the source
and certificates already used that correct domain. Formal forests are not
claimed geometric examples. Earlier407.5 and ambient60 deficits are resolved.

The compact arithmetic H13/Q(sqrt5) lane now has
[joint raw56/raw57/raw76 marker inequalities](results/fresh_raw56_raw57_raw76_joint_marker_family_20261018.md):
1,643 complete source classes and1,430 new columns share vertex allowances
while retaining compatible unknowns and all predecessor costs. The exact
fixed-mass repair is **12.018969384494238**, still above12. No optimizer
was run and this is not a global optimum or an arithmetic dimension theorem.
The [four-core pilot](results/fresh_raw14_raw112_raw77_raw108_core_incidence_pilot_20261018.md)
finds two extra vertices in each raw112/raw108 core, with bounded native
recovery checks and a complete metadata inventory. It establishes no new
pair capacity, column or multiplier improvement.

The [oblique-R closure experiment](results/fresh_moving64_oblique_r_closure_20261018.md)
changes the closing incidence and reconstructs M in reverse. Fifty-two
configurations pass all native/common-center gates and complete numerical
target-cone/PD comparisons, closing J and X. Each still has21 finite target
rays and13 open ends; both52-side corners fail. The exact original debit
remains19 finite supports,12 compact two-faces and one compact three-face.
New normals remain numerical, and no completed chamber or finite-volume
example is established. The next construction must address the52-side region.

The [preceding bound61 checkpoint](results/ambient62_ideal_closure_and_current_search_20261018.md)
([final consistency review](results/ambient62_ideal_closure_and_current_search_20261018_review.md))
completes the ambient-dimension-62 comparison. Two order14 ideal transfers
make all 2,641 terminal cusp margins positive, with actual surplus at least
73. The finite D17 reduction and rank15/rank16 exchanges lower the complete
finite maximum to 434, equal to curvature. The A17 restoration is counted;
all 1,227 fixed-component alternatives are covered. Their contradiction is

    0 >= 0*v_f + 73*v_i + 4805 > 0.

The preceding bound62 supplies the higher-dimensional tail. Final generation,
fresh replay and three peer mathematical composition reviews pass. There is
no identified unresolved step in this internally checked proof. The same
checkpoint records the new arithmetic optimum above12 and a numerical
construction seam that still fails to close.

The [preceding bound62 checkpoint](results/dimension62_sparse_coupons_and_wall66_20261018.md)
combines three universal ideal transfers with sparse finite payments.
Order 11, 12 and 13 factor-cost maxima become 54, 63 and 147/2.
Finite A16/D16/D17 costs become 114/114/125. All nine added component-pair
payments fit a complete rank-63 maximum of 449, below curvature 899/2.

An independent reconstruction of all 2,204 terminal cusp profiles gives
normalized margin at least 3505/201344 and absolute surplus at least 139/46.
A hypothetical dimension-63 polytope would therefore satisfy

    0 >= (1/2)*v_f + (139/46)*v_i + 4960,

which is impossible. The completed ceiling 63 supplies all higher dimensions.
Generation, fresh replay and three full internal mathematical composition
reviews pass. The proof handles changed actual corners before applying
the finite theorem under unchanged ideal weights. Every added payment is
included in the finite bound. Historical geometric censuses retain their
recorded verif

GOAL.md.opening:
# Research Goal

**Current dimension gate (2026-10-18):** the repository's complete, internally
checked proof chain bounds finite-sided, finite-volume real hyperbolic
Coxeter polytopes by59 and compact arithmetic Coxeter polytopes by21.
These results have not received
external mathematician refereeing or proof-assistant formalization. The
[current checkpoint](results/dimension59_three_corner_payments_and_oblique_closure_20261018.md)
records their scope and validation status. The newer ambient59 search still
has finite and ideal obstructions; it is not a completed bound58 proof.

The published noncompact arithmetic bound21, with dimension20 excluded,
remains a separate input; Borcherds attains21 in that noncompact class.
Arbitrary compact Coxeter polytopes retain the published bound29. Under the
current internal theorems, a dimension22 construction must be nonarithmetic;
a compact arithmetic host over a nonrational field cannot evade the21 bound.
The compact H9 construction objective remains open, and no new finite-volume
example has been established. See [the current search plan](RESEARCH_PLAN.md).

## Objective

Advance both boundaries of the compact hyperbolic Coxeter-polytope problem:
construct examples beyond the present dimension-8 frontier while sharpening
the universal nonexistence boundary from the other side.  The first concrete
combinatorial benchmark remains a publication-grade result at dimension 9:

- construct and exactly certify a compact Coxeter polytope in \(\mathbb H^9\);
  or
- exactly and exhaustively exclude the first facet class unresolved in the
  published literature, compact 9-polytopes with 14 facets, thereby giving a
  public proof of \(D(5)\leq8\), and carry the certified method to the next open
  facet class.

In parallel, turn the accumulating examples into a structural theorem:
classify when a rational or integral hyperbolic Coxeter polytope admits an
algebraic carrier, first on a K3 surface and then on Enriques, rational, and
projective hyperkähler varieties.  The intended gain is to replace part of
the discrete polytope search by the softer existence and moduli theory of
lattice-polarized varieties, while retaining exact Coxeter and Vinberg gates.
The structural endpoint is an **inverse-carrier transfer theorem**: for a
class specified entirely by Coxeter, Gram, and lattice conditions, existence
of a polytope is equivalent to nonemptiness of a moduli problem of strongly
Coxeter-marked varieties.  Classification, boundedness, or emptiness on the
variety side can then be transferred back to an existence, finiteness, or
nonexistence theorem for the polytopes.

**Global AGCat milestone (2026-08-12).**  A broader exact algebraic carrier
now gives the requested all-dimensional finiteness pushback without claiming
that every chamber is a surface nef cone.  Every finite-sided finite-volume
arithmetic Coxeter chamber in the standard Vinberg quadratic/lattice model
maps functorially to its real-framed projective quadric--polar-hyperplane
arrangement, and the framing and polarity return the identical chamber.
ABSW Lemma 5.2, citing Vinberg Lemma 7, supplies the structural reduction of
arithmetic reflection inputs to that model; it contributes no finiteness
conclusion.
Integral Cartan-cycle functions on that arrangement, together with the
dimension-`>=6` minimality-14 funnel, exact dimension-`4/5` descent, the
compact `H3` fork theorem, and the `H2` orbifold-curve theorem, give a finite
global set of minimal Vinberg fields.  The independent geometric ceiling
`n<=995`, the connected-frame constant `A=62`, a reconstructed full-order
conductor proof for fixed field and rank, and reflection maximality then give
finitely many unmarked normalized maximal chambers and reflection groups.
This theorem is **AG-mediated, not AG-only**: the dimension and frame bounds
are classical Coxeter geometry, while the old fixed-data reflective-lattice
finiteness conclusion is not imported.  The direct degree implication
`AG-DEG`, surface Property 4, and an AG-only proof remain open.  See the
[terminal synthesis](results/exact_agcat_functor_and_ag_finiteness_pushback_synthesis.md)
and [global composite theorem](results/agcat_global_maximal_arithmetic_coxeter_finiteness.md)
(SHA-256
`441deb5a379fc59c6b4c1e1e86212f5f84db4e603a4b37259200db43a4508dfd`),
whose [independent composition audit](results/agcat_global_maximal_arithmetic_coxeter_finiteness_independent_hostile_audit.md)
is terminal PASS (SHA-256
`6fbf3f5954d66390e82916b3fd68720ba58ed106c681e7ff7196f8e30667a44e`;
full relevant suite `31 passed`).
The [canonical scope addendum](results/canonical_chamber_four_property_completion_global_agcat_addendum.md)
records why this does not alter the frozen negative surface-Property-4
verdict.

**Silver Lambda22 global nonreflectivity theorem (2026-08-13).**  The
previously bounded strongest lane now has a terminal host-level verdict.  For

\[
 M=\langle-(\sqrt2-1)\rangle\oplus\Lambda_{22}
 \quad\text{over }\mathbf Z[\sqrt2],
\]

put `d=e1`, with `d^2=4`.  The explicit integral Lorentz isometry

\[
 g(x,y)=\bigl((5+4\sqrt2)x+(4+3\sqrt2)(d,y),
 y+((2+\sqrt2)x+(1+\sqrt2)(d,y))d\bigr)
\]

has infinite order and sends `v0=(1,0)` to
`(5+4sqrt(2),(2+sqrt(2))d)`.  Any reflective mirror separating those two
points would have Vinberg height at most `56+40sqrt(2)<150` and would pair
positively with `z=(1,d/3)`.  The complete first packet and exact frontier
through `H=150` exclude every such mirror; the complete eight-class norm
alphabet also excludes a mirror through `v0`.  Hence `g` stabilizes one
chamber of the full mirror arrangement.  Its infinitely many disjoint
translates of a small open ball prove that chamber has infinite volume, so
the full reflection subgroup has infinite index in the cocompact arithmetic
group `O+(M)`.  Consequently this host admits no finite-covolume integral
reflection subgroup.  This is global nonreflectivity for one exact host, not
a field-wide or dimension-wide nonexistence th
